name: khatamat
description: khatamat (ختمات): the next verse of the Quran in a popup at the interval you choose, in order from Al-Fatiha to An-Nas and around again, with the Saheeh International English translation. /quran opens a pane to browse verses.

every.title: Show a verse every
every.description: How many minutes or hours between two popups (see the unit option).

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Whether the interval above counts minutes or hours.

closeAfterSeconds.title: Popup stays for (seconds)
closeAfterSeconds.description: How long each verse popup stays on screen before it closes by itself.

wordsPerLine.title: Words per line
wordsPerLine.description: Most words on one line of the verse in the pane. Long verses are split into even lines.

translation.title: English translation
translation.description: Show the English translation (Saheeh International, Tarteel QUL) under the verse in the pane.
